checks: PostgreSQL concurrent replay, stale-writer fencing and outbox/inbox verification
database session lock serializes login replacement with purchases; stale queued writers are rejected
real broker: SIGKILL after publish and after consumer commit; replay applies each side effect once
loopback readiness checks dependencies; metrics expose queues, connections, RPC, GC and durable outbox lag
mTLS rejects absent certificate, untrusted issuer, unauthorized subject and wrong server name
anonymous, cross-player, expired identities and CA-trusted non-member node credentials rejected
replacement login revokes old calls; late logout is safe; reconnect authenticates and resynchronizes without duplicate assets
shared Room Actor authorizes current membership; outsiders and revoked members are rejected
generated client purchase and repeated operation ID commit once
independent C# 9 V1 client reads V2 DTO and stable protocol ID over TLS
killed owner replaced; PostgreSQL fence advances; replay survives process loss
SIGSTOP owner replaced; resumed old process cannot restore its generation or duplicate purchase
Redis outage stops Actor Tick/DB renewal and RPC; recovery preserves committed state
PostgreSQL outage fails readiness and asset access; expired owners retire and replay preserves assets after recovery
blocked purchase produces explicit SERVER_BUSY under a burst; same connection recovers
normal, larger payload, hot-Actor load and 20 fresh client sessions preserve state
open-loop mixed purchase/read/echo load retains offered, dropped, rejected and scheduled-arrival latency; SQL assets reconcile
capacity driver executes two isolated steps and records evidence without certifying a short run or an absent SLO
drain waits for an admitted blocked purchase, stops new admission, and hands off without duplicating assets
previous and candidate binaries mixed, rolled back and upgraded; old client survives; strict sessions enabled last
owner leaf/key rotation changes the served certificate; fresh authenticated RPC succeeds and unauthorized peers remain rejected
